record.name: GoHighLevel
record.one_liner: An all-in-one marketing, sales, and CRM platform providing tools for agencies and businesses.
record.access_note: API access is available on paid subscription plans such as Starter, Unlimited, and Agency Pro.
record.api_note: Our API includes REST endpoints for contacts, messaging, workflows, calendars, payments, webhooks, and more.

evidence.quote: HighLevel supports: Private Integration Tokens for internal or single-location integrations OAuth 2.0 for public integrations
HighLevel provides API access across all subscription plans, including Starter, Unlimited, and Agency Pro.
Our API includes REST endpoints for contacts, messaging, workflows, calendars, payments, webhooks, and more.
